paper_title: Dual Modality-Aware Gated Prompt Tuning for Few-Shot Multimodal Sarcasm   Detection
caption: Effect of Prompt Length
model_annotation: The line plot, titled "Prompt Length vs Accuracy," illustrates the relationship between prompt length and accuracy for two models, mmstd and mmstd2, across a range of prompt lengths from 2 to 16. The x-axis, labeled "Prompt Length," is a linear scale with integer values at intervals of 2, ranging from 2 to 16. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy," is also a linear scale ranging from 77 to 81, with major gridlines at intervals of 1. The red line, representing the mmstd model, begins at an accuracy of approximately 81.0 when the prompt length is 2, decreases slightly to about 80.4 at a prompt length of 4, and then gradually increases to a peak of approximately 80.8 at a prompt length of 8 before leveling off and slightly decreasing to around 80.6 at a prompt length of 16. The yellow line, representing the mmstd2 model, starts at an accuracy of about 77.4 at a prompt length of 2, drops to a minimum of approximately 76.6 at a prompt length of 4, rises to a peak of about 77.2 at a prompt length of 8, and then steadily declines to a final value of approximately 76.2 at a prompt length of 16.
